articles.headline: Fest’In Folk Corredoura Brings Eight Days Of World Dance To Guimarães
articles.description: Fest’In Folk Corredoura brought eight days of folk dance, music and traditional culture to Guimarães from 3 to 10 August 2026, documented for Image Media by Paulo Nomade.

articles.headline: Prime Hybrid Espinho Passes 600 Registrations With €3,500 Prize Pool Announced
articles.description: Portugal's first fully urban hybrid fitness race is targeting 800 athletes for its inaugural edition on 26 September.

articles.headline: Inaugural AVYNT Ergathlon Held in Vila Nova de Gaia
articles.description: The inaugural AVYNT Ergathlon brought athletes to Vila Nova de Gaia on 15 August for a night-time indoor endurance competition.

articles.headline: Ivrea Crowns 2026 Italian Canoe Slalom and Kayak Cross Champions
articles.description: Italy crowned its 2026 senior canoe slalom and kayak cross champions in Ivrea, one month before the venue hosts the European Championships.
articles.homepageAlt: A canoe slalom athlete paddles through white water at the 2026 Italian Championships in Ivrea
articles.breakingText: Italy crowned its 2026 canoe slalom and kayak cross champions in Ivrea, one month before the European Championships return to the Dora Baltea.

articles.headline: KIDSROX Brings Youth Fitness Racing to Dublin
articles.description: Elite Fitness KIDSROX brought age-group fitness racing to Dublin on 30 August, with young athletes tackling running and functional challenges.
articles.homepageAlt: Three young KIDSROX athletes hold first, second and third-place banners in Dublin
articles.breakingText: KIDSROX brought young athletes and families together in Dublin for a day of age-group fitness racing.

articles.headline: Eames and Prim Win Portmarnock Beach 5K as 446 Finishers Race the Sand
articles.description: Anthony Eames and Rebekka Prim won the 2026 Portmarnock AC Beach 5K as 446 finishers raced across the Velvet Strand in Dublin.
articles.homepageAlt: A large field of runners races across Portmarnock Beach during the 2026 Beach 5K
articles.breakingText: Anthony Eames and Rebekka Prim won the Portmarnock Beach 5K as 446 finishers raced across the Velvet Strand.

articles.headline: Raúl Cámara and Claudia Gutiérrez Win Trail de Ubiña in Asturias
articles.description: Raúl Cámara Pérez and Claudia Gutiérrez Lueje won the 21 km Trail de Ubiña as 273 classified finishers raced across two mountain courses in Asturias.
articles.homepageAlt: Trail runners climb through the Macizo de Ubiña mountains during the 2026 race
articles.breakingText: Raúl Cámara and Claudia Gutiérrez won the Trail de Ubiña as 273 classified finishers raced through the Asturian mountains.

articles.headline: Fabio Lanzone and Annalisa Prato Win Haute Route Alps 2026
articles.description: Seven stages carried riders from Nice to Thonon-les-Bains across 808 km and 19,255 metres of climbing, with Fabio Lanzone and Annalisa Prato taking the overall titles.
articles.homepageAlt: Cyclists climb through Savoie beneath dark Alpine clouds during Haute Route Alps 2026
articles.breakingText: Fabio Lanzone and Annalisa Prato won Haute Route Alps 2026 after seven stages, 808 km and 19,255 metres of climbing.

articles.headline: World Surf League Makes Leça da Palmeira Debut at QS 6000
articles.description: The World Surf League has arrived in Leça da Palmeira for a new QS 6000 International, bringing 224 surfers to Matosinhos from 1–6 September.
articles.homepageAlt: Surfer drives through a cutback as spray arcs above a green wave in Leça da Palmeira
articles.breakingText: The World Surf League has arrived in Leça da Palmeira for a new QS 6,000 International.
